legal.draft: Preview document. Business details and this notice must be completed and reviewed before publication.

sections.title: BMYGYM
paragraphs: Bespoke Longevity Environments. Founder: Bojana Pesic. Valencia, Spain. Contact: hello@bmygym.com.

sections.title: Business information pending
paragraphs: The legal entity or proprietor’s registered details, postal address, tax identification and any applicable registry information must be supplied before this notice can be finalised.

sections.title: Concept visualisations
paragraphs: The architectural environments and Signature Concepts presented on this website are design visualisations. They do not establish that a product has been manufactured, a project has been completed, or aircraft equipment has been certified.

AERO ONE is a transformable recovery and longevity chair concept in development for private aviation. It is not certified or commercially available. Aviation concepts remain subject to aircraft-specific technical feasibility, safety and certification requirements.

sections.title: Project engagements
paragraphs: The Private Longevity Blueprint is a professional concept and design service that begins with a formal, paid commission. Scope, deliverables and fees are agreed before design starts. Subsequent design, product selection, manufacturing coordination and integration phases are commissioned separately as required. No purchase or payment is taken through this website.

sections.title: About this notice
paragraphs: This preview describes the enquiry functionality prepared for BMYGYM. It is not a final approved privacy notice.

sections.title: Information you provide
paragraphs: The project enquiry form requests your full name, email address, client profile, project type and project description. You may also provide your company and project location. The selected website language accompanies your enquiry to support our response. Please do not include sensitive health information.

sections.title: Purpose and delivery
paragraphs: Information is used to respond to your project enquiry. When email delivery is configured, the form sends it through Resend to BMYGYM at hello@bmygym.com. This website does not store enquiries in an application database.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: For questions about information you share, contact hello@bmygym.com.

sections.title: Information pending before publication
paragraphs: The final notice must identify the legal data controller and contact address, applicable lawful basis, retention periods, processor arrangements, any international transfer safeguards, and how to exercise applicable rights or contact the competent supervisory authority.
These details have not yet been supplied or approved. The final notice will be based on the actual business and its handling of enquiries.

sections.title: Current website configuration
paragraphs: This version does not install analytics, advertising, tracking pixels, embedded social widgets or other optional cookie-based services. Fonts and images are served by the website itself. Language selection is reflected in the URL and does not require a cookie.

sections.title: Your preferences
paragraphs: There are currently no non-essential cookies to accept or reject. You can review the current status at any time using Cookie Settings in the footer.

sections.title: Before adding optional services
paragraphs: If optional tracking or embedded services are introduced, this notice and the consent controls must be updated so visitors can accept, reject or later change their preferences before those services load.
The final production hosting configuration and cookie inventory must be checked before publication.

sections.title: Our approach
paragraphs: BMYGYM aims to make its website clear and usable across devices and ways of browsing, in English, German, French, Spanish and Russian.

sections.title: Using this website
paragraphs: You can navigate links and form controls using a keyboard. A skip link is available at the beginning of each page. The mobile navigation and language selector can be closed with Escape. Images include descriptive alternatives, forms use visible labels, and the website respects your reduced-motion preference.

sections.title: Contact us
paragraphs: If you encounter a barrier or would prefer to enquire directly, please email hello@bmygym.com. Include the page and any information that would help us understand the issue.
This information does not constitute a formal accessibility certification.
